scope: WebUI-only v0.2.5 completion, public release, and production online verification

historicalThreadContext.title: v0.2.2
historicalThreadContext.takeaway: Feishu backend success is not enough; EcoreX must persist app_id/app_secret locally, and release packages must carry lark_oapi plus writeback compatibility.

historicalThreadContext.title: v0.2.3
historicalThreadContext.takeaway: Tool recovery must prove real model tool_call and runtime execution, not UI ready-only state; package/runtime gates and privacy evidence must fail closed.

historicalThreadContext.title: usage reporting
historicalThreadContext.takeaway: Web UI fixes should avoid hardcoded ranges, support user-selected state, and prevent hover/help UI from visually blocking primary controls.

historicalThreadContext.title: v0.2.4-v0.2.5
historicalThreadContext.takeaway: v0.2.5 release work must keep WebUI artifact metadata, public manifest, installation manifest, deployment evidence, and privacy redaction aligned.

changes: Feishu CLI auth login now registers an internal auth_login session, preserves the device code server-side, and lets agent_auth_status continue the CLI writeback after the user authorizes the official link.
Feishu CLI can use controlled system Node/npm/npx when enabled, while global system lark-cli remains rejected.

Structured Feishu CLI status, diagnose, install, auth, config, and run actions are allowed through the wrapper so normal read/write workflows do not get blocked by EcoreX confirmation in Web runtimes.
Tongxin CLI has a default auth/bootstrap address, state-backed bootstrap_dir, EcoreX-owned python_path support, and a runpy shim for user-provided xin_agent_cli.py.
Tongxin remains read-only by default; mutating Tongxin commands are still denied before subprocess execution.
WebUI sidebar now separates general pinned sessions from regular sessions with distinct group headings.
Pinned general sessions sort by latest pinned time first, then by activity; unpinned sessions keep the existing activity order.
Project sessions do not leave their project when pinned; pinning only changes order inside the owning project/group.
Runtime UI state persists pinnedSessionTimes and repairs/removes stale pin timestamps during session cleanup.
Release manifest, public page assets, installer scripts, Web service package, and /api/version are aligned to 0.2.5.

validation.webuiLocalReleasePackaging: pass for Windows and macOS WebUI artifacts; optional combined win-mac zip intentionally omitted for Web-only release

preservedContracts: This release remains WebUI-only; native desktop installer/DMG artifacts are not promoted.
System shell/raw bash access is still not opened by the structured-tool permission change.
System Node allowance is scoped to Feishu CLI Node/npm/npx and does not allow system lark-cli.
Tongxin write operations remain blocked by read-only policy.
Pinned project sessions remain inside their project scope.
